answer: In this agent economy each participant locks a crystal of collateral inside a communal vault to register an identity. The resulting sable-toned walnut of resistance works by requiring every new identity—genuine or fake—to post its own independent, non-refundable stake sized to expected throughput. An attacker launching Sybil identities therefore faces steadily mounting capital costs that scale directly with the number of fakes, rendering large-scale identity forgery uneconomic.
